Every evaluation has a valid warm boundary; data_fingerprint and scenario_signature equal R resolved inputs; ordered_symbols equal the formal order; raw_frame_hashes and indicator_hashes key sets equal ordered_symbols; both old-symbol equality flags are true; calendar_hash equals the frozen provider calendar hash.
Every numeric field required by the selected candidate slice and its factual trace schema is finite; ablation/control values are validated separately and never used as candidate gates.
For every selected-candidate L1 evaluation (C6-Base+AB5 or C6-Base+AB5+S, never baseline/ablation/W), abs(unrounded official_metrics.max_drawdown) <= 0.18 + 1e-15.
minimum over prefix-05..17 adjacent pairs of (wealth_right/wealth_left)-1 >= -0.30 - 1e-12
minimum terminal_wealth ratio over every formal prefix except prefix-05 (prefix-01..04 and prefix-06..17) versus exact reference >= 0.95 - 1e-12
Every frozen permutation sentinel in the selected-candidate slice has maximum numeric deviation <=1e-12 with identical reason attribution and terminal lock.
All 15 recording-off/on pairs have identical canonical hashes for orders, fills, cash, positions and equity.
Base requires all 29 exact Base controls; Base+S requires all 4 exact S controls plus all common-prefix and no-S-effect cross-producer comparisons.

C6-Base+AB5+S.count: exact recomputed match count; zero allowed

L1_APPLICABLE_DIAGNOSTIC_PREDICATES.formula: three independent sleeves, distributed alpha, centralized veto, unchanged account lock, no allocator, no candidate runtime switch and no uquant runtime dependency

L2_APPLICABLE_DIAGNOSTIC_PREDICATES.formula: actual ordered scenario IDs exactly equal the frozen 77-ID L2 manifest including SHA-256
every required diagnostic result metric is finite
minimum over all adjacent prefix pairs of (wealth_right/wealth_left)-1 >= -0.30 - 1e-12
minimum other-prefix terminal wealth ratio versus exact reference >= 0.95 - 1e-12
minimum current add-one wealth change minus exact-reference minimum add-one wealth change >= -0.03 - 1e-12
maximum frozen-field deviation within each included seed permutation group <= 1e-12

economic_tree_and_A.allowed_change: only add or modify regular non-executable 100644 blobs at exact allowlisted paths; no delete, rename, symlink or gitlink

economic_tree_and_A.runner_read_exclusion: No A_ALLOWLIST path is read by the official runner, gate implementation, scenario generator, dependency/config loader or C6 selection validator. implementation_identity_rules.I_B_comparison_base: the exact containing P commit recorded by R; its tree must equal the containing P tree and P must be the first-parent ancestor of I_B
implementation_identity_rules.I_B_diff: git diff --raw -z and git diff --numstat -z over P_commit..I_B_commit; every changed path must be an exact I_B_allowed_paths member; no rename, copy, delete, symlink, gitlink, submodule, mode change or path outside the allowlist

L4_official_output_selector.post_run_contract: Exit 0 requires only accepted_exit_0_path to be newly written; exit 2 requires only the resolved rejected path to be newly written. Both, neither, a symlink, any pre-existing target, or a path for another revision is invalid.

R_schema.P_expansion_rule: R replaces every argv occurrence of every P_compile_time_slot exactly once. Any remaining argv brace must name a declared runtime_late_slot. OUTPUT_PATH and CHILD_CHECKPOINT_PATH are wrapper-resolved from the actual initial/resume attempt only after history and fencing validation, using R_paths; they cannot be frozen to a0 or supplied by the dispatcher. RUN_BINDINGS_PATH is replaced only by the wrapper with the absolute, read-only path already validated from its --bindings-file argument; its file must be the exact run_bindings_revision blob from the separate bindings checkout and must not be copied into source. For c6.base_plus_s.l1 the wrapper must validate the direct qualification producer, read its base_producer_identity, resolve that exact transitive Base artifact, and replace both BASE_PRODUCER_* slots; the runtime binding signature covers both producer identities. A declared direct producer runtime slot may be wrapper-only for L4 because the unchanged official stress child does not consume L2 evidence; the wrapper must still resolve and validate both direct producer slots before child import. Unknown/missing required slots, duplicate record IDs, non-allowlisted entrypoints or argv differences are invalid.

R_schema.signature_serialization: canonical_json_v2 means json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) encoded UTF-8 plus exactly one trailing LF; strict parsing rejects duplicate/non-string keys and non-finite numbers

run_templates.binding_lookup: The pair (workflow binding_id, candidate_id) must match exactly one R record; record_id is unique. No user-selected entrypoint, module, argv prefix, payload schema or source alias exists.

binding_specs.producer_policy: exact successful complete sealed qualification result plus its exact transitive c6.base.l1 producer; wrapper must resolve and validate both before child import

child_environment.rule: No other C6_* variable reaches the child. The token is a runner-generated concurrency nonce, not an authentication secret or workflow-dispatch input. It is masked before any later step and may exist only in wrapper/child process environment; raw bytes are forbidden from argv, logs, downloaded/uploaded artifacts, payloads, checkpoints, envelopes and sidecars, where only SHA-256 may persist. C6_BOUND_RESUME_SIGNATURE exists only after the wrapper authenticates a prior diagnostic checkpoint; it binds the old signature while the new attempt writes its fresh signature.

deterministic_runtime.python_patch: resolved exactly in R from a successful non-economic runner probe

run_templates.execution_owner: GitHub Actions C6 Bound Economic Run only
run_templates.no_runtime_candidate_switch: I_B contains only Base production behavior and cannot execute S, while its diagnostic entrypoint records the preregistered read-only S qualification evidence. I_S is I_B plus the one frozen S production behavior. Candidate selection occurs solely by exact source checkout and R record.
run_templates.output_paths: R derives wrapper-owned normalized paths under artifacts/checkpoints/c6/{logical_run_id}/; no placeholder may select an importable package path. RUN_BINDINGS_PATH is an absolute read-only input under the separate bindings checkout. L4 additionally permits only the two frozen official child publication targets in L4_official_output_selector inside the ephemeral source checkout; the wrapper copies exactly one byte-for-byte into its export and does not retain a source-tree mutation. Fresh diagnostics use payload.json.gz and internal child-checkpoint.bin.gz; sealed checkpoint member remains child-checkpoint.bin. Compression is transport only and is frozen in canonical_result_payload_hashing.diagnostic_transport.

workflow.fencing_token_generation: The pinned workflow generates a fresh 64-lowercase-hex run-local nonce with Python secrets before input validation, masks it immediately, and passes it only through GITHUB_ENV and the wrapper/child process environments.
workflow.post_D_anchor: For L2/L4 the checked-out D commit has exactly one parent equal run_bindings_revision and its only diff is A artifacts/diagnostics/c6-selection.json; any other parent/path/status is invalid.
workflow.pre_import_anchor: Before checkout or import, git ls-remote --refs on the public repository must return exactly source_revision at the candidate's trusted source ref. With empty D, evidence-ref head must equal run_bindings_revision. With nonempty D, evidence-ref head must equal d_commit.

c6.base.l1.derivation: In order: prefix every L1_BASE_EVALUATION_MANIFEST ID with evaluation/; prefix every L1_BASE_SYNTHETIC_CONTROL_IDS ID with control/; prefix every L1_INSTRUMENTATION_NO_DRIFT_SCENARIO_IDS ID with no-drift/.

c6.base_plus_s.l1.derivation: In order: prefix every L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST ID with evaluation/; prefix every L1_S_SYNTHETIC_CONTROL_IDS ID with control/; prefix every L1_INSTRUMENTATION_NO_DRIFT_SCENARIO_IDS ID with no-drift/. Cross-producer common-prefix and no-S-effect comparisons are payload-level validations over economic evaluations and are not additional economic evaluations; S controls remain fixture-only non-economic assertion records.

c6.s.qualification.derivation: After exact Base producer validation, mechanically derive R_L1 from the 765 C6-Base+AB5 evaluation records using S_QUALIFICATION_RUN.residual_formula, sort the complete residual IDs lexicographically, and prefix each with qualification/. Empty residuals prohibit this binding rather than producing an empty run. The resolved count/hash become binding-signature and checkpoint inputs before the first item executes.

c6.selected.l2.derivation: Prefix every L2_EXACT_SCENARIO_IDS ID, in its listed frozen order, with scenario/.

c6.selected.l4.derivation: Prefix every canonical formal generator-order scenario ID with scenario/. This is not lexicographic order; it is exact stress_scenarios._multi_seed_scenarios generator order used by the official checkpoint.

EXECUTION_ITEM_MANIFESTS.serialization: UTF-8; exact listed/derived order; one item ID per line with a final LF; SHA-256 over exact bytes

generation: For each variant in exact order [baseline,F0-only,F0+F1,U-only,C6-Base+AB5], emit `${variant}::${scenario_id}` for every L1_ECONOMIC_SCENARIO_IDS entry in its frozen lexicographic order.
Then emit W0-no-601869 through W5-full-base-production-pool-relative-no-lock, in numeric order, each paired only with add-one-13-601869.

L1_INSTRUMENTATION_NO_DRIFT_SCENARIO_IDS.semantics: Run the selected stage candidate once with factual recording disabled and once enabled; compare the five canonical path hashes exactly. These pairs are additional nonpromotable checks and are not residual candidates.

L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST.base_counterpart_rule: For each exact C6-Base+AB5+S::<scenario_id> evaluation ID, the sole authorized Base counterpart is C6-Base+AB5::<the identical scenario_id> in the transitive sealed c6.base.l1 producer. Prefix replacement is byte-exact; lookup must return exactly one record or the payload is invalid.
L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST.generation: Emit `C6-Base+AB5+S::${scenario_id}` for every L1_ECONOMIC_SCENARIO_IDS entry in frozen lexicographic order.
L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST.synthetic_control_rule: The four S controls are fixture-only, have economic_fields=null and are never members of cross-producer no_effect_comparisons. Their exact assertions_by_control specs are self-contained contracts; s/no-op-control/v1 records s_effective_count=0 and recomputes equality of orders, fills, cash, positions and equity hashes inside the fixture before emitting its three non-economic assertions.

scenario_manifests.serialization: UTF-8; IDs in each manifest's explicitly documented order (lexicographic where stated, listed order otherwise); one ID per line; LF after every line including the last; SHA-256 over exact bytes

D_selection.union_validation: Exactly one branch variant must match every field. Static contract tests must instantiate and accept each of the five branch variants, then reject a missing branch, an unknown branch and every cross-branch field combination. No downstream artifact may be retained after BASE_REJECTED. Invalid Base/Base+S payload, malformed/incomplete qualification, or invalid producer is abnormal and stops without D.

array_order.no_effect_comparisons: all qualifying evaluation IDs in L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST order

cross_field_invariants.common_prefix_counterpart: Every common_prefix_comparison.scenario_id equals the C6-Base+AB5+S evaluation_id at the same ordinal and base_evaluation_id equals C6-Base+AB5::<the identical scenario suffix>; first_s_effective_timestamp is recomputed from that S record and both prefix hashes are recomputed at the identical strict-before boundary.
cross_field_invariants.common_prefix_coverage: common_prefix_comparisons length is exactly 765 and scenario_id sequence exactly equals L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST IDs
cross_field_invariants.no_effect_counterpart: Every no_effect_comparison.item_kind is evaluation, item_id equals its exact C6-Base+AB5+S evaluation_id, base_evaluation_id equals C6-Base+AB5::<the identical scenario suffix>, and s_effective_count is recomputed from that S record before all five complete-path hashes are recomputed.
cross_field_invariants.no_effect_coverage: length equals the complete count of L1_S evaluations with s_effective_count=0 and item_id sequence equals the frozen filtered L1_S_EVALUATION_MANIFEST order; synthetic controls are forbidden; missing, duplicate or extra entries are invalid
cross_field_invariants.producer_binding: For each comparison, parse the scenario suffix from the C6-Base+AB5+S item/scenario ID, derive base_evaluation_id exactly as C6-Base+AB5::<same suffix>, require exactly one matching evaluation_record in the transitive sealed c6.base.l1 producer, and recompute every Base hash from that exact record. Every S hash is recomputed from the exact same-ID evaluation in this payload. A hash copied from any different Base/S record is invalid.

selection_rule.step_1: Run exactly c6.base.l1 and validate the entire 3831-evaluation/29-control/15-no-drift payload.
selection_rule.step_2: Invalid Base identity/schema cannot produce D or a successor. A/B defects invalidate the execution revision and are repaired/rebound under recovery_continuation; a valid economic diagnostic rejection follows this same mechanical selection contract. S is never used to disguise a correctness defect.
selection_rule.step_3: Derive complete R_L1 only from the 765 C6-Base+AB5 evaluation records using the frozen unrounded MDD predicate.
selection_rule.step_4: If R_L1 is empty, do not dispatch qualification or Base+S. Select I_B iff every Base L1 predicate passes; otherwise reject.
selection_rule.step_5: If R_L1 is nonempty, dispatch exactly c6.s.qualification with the exact Base producer. Base+S is eligible only if the complete qualification result has all_passed=true.
selection_rule.step_6: If qualified, dispatch exactly c6.base_plus_s.l1 with the exact qualification producer and its transitive Base identity. Select I_S iff every Base+S L1 predicate passes; otherwise reject.
selection_rule.step_7: D binds P/R, every required sealed artifact hash, complete residual IDs, predicate arrays, qualification hash or null, selected candidate and exact C. Preselection artifacts remain unselected and are never rewritten.
selection_rule.step_8: Only the D-selected candidate-specific L2 record may dispatch. L4 requires the exact successful complete L2 producer, every L2 predicate passed, and the same D/C.

stop_conditions: Do not dispatch a new economic execution until exact new P/I_B/I_S/R and real boundary/cloud probe evidence are remotely verified.
Do not mutate old frozen objects or resume the invalid v11 logical run.

Any identity, data, schema, formula, runtime or history mismatch blocks the affected execution; classify A/B/C/D under authority.recovery_continuation. A/B recovery is already authorized and preserves history.
Unauthorized warm holdings/cash/peaks/orders/locks or future information, invalid raw data or universe-dependent old-symbol indicators cannot be accepted.
A valid Base residual qualification failure, eligible Base+S predicate failure, selected L2 failure or formal L4 gate rejection blocks promotion under the frozen mechanical rules.
No third candidate, tuning, economic threshold/scenario/reference changes, allocator or account-lock weakening.
Native GitHub rerun, missing/expired history, a prior run without valid sealed evidence, duplicate result or broken producer lineage permanently invalidates that logical run; never forge a successor.
L4 exit2 is a valid economic rejection when its schema/provenance and native gates validate; no resume or renamed rerun for outcome selection.
Required checks/reviews and GitHub protection must pass at the exact head. Main drift permits normal merge and actual dependency revalidation; no bypass or unsupported extra expected-base CAS.
Any recovered result must carry truthful source/data/runtime. Old observations never become an independent out-of-sample result by changing a revision name.
AB5 locked diagnostics cannot substitute for fresh full Base L1, selected L2 or official17/958; no accepted/canonical claim before all formal gates.
unknowns_before_implementation: Exact I_B and I_S commit/tree/blob identities are unknown until their reviewed clean trees are frozen; P supplies only exact construction and R schemas.
Exact R commit/blob/full-byte identity is unknown until both implementations and runtime probe values are frozen.
Base residual IDs and S qualification outcome are intentionally unknown until the one bound Base L1 result; they cannot alter S code, formulas or schemas.
D, C and downstream producer artifact hashes are intentionally unknown until mechanical selection; only their exact late-binding schemas are open.
New revision economic results remain unknown. Historical transition report and old 530 baseline observations have been seen and retained; no new economic replay is used to design this repair.
